Intro TL;DR.

I'm Elisabetta — I started in product management, working closely with founders and teams to turn ideas into real products. Along the way, I realised I cared just as much about how things feel as how they work.

Over the past 4+ years across startups and corporates, I've helped shape products from concept to launch. That naturally led me into UX design and research, where I can get closer to the problems behind the product — not just the delivery.

Now, I design with that same mindset — combining product thinking with hands-on research to create experiences that are grounded in real user needs and built to work in the real world.
